meta.name: ChatApp
meta.summary: A real‑time text chat application with user authentication, room management, and instant messaging.
meta.problem: Users need a simple, secure, and fast way to communicate in real time across multiple chat rooms without the complexity of existing solutions.
goals: Enable secure user registration and authentication with JWT tokens.
Support creation, listing, and joining of chat rooms.
Provide instant message sending and real‑time delivery.
Store message history with pagination for rooms.
targetUsers: Developers looking for a lightweight chat service

features.name: User Registration & Authentication
features.description: Allows new users to sign up and existing users to log in, returning a JWT token for protected endpoints.
features.userStory: As a new user, I want to register with a username and password so that I can access the chat service.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user submits a valid username and password to /api/auth/register
acceptanceCriteria.then: a new user record is created and a success response with a JWT token is returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: An existing user submits correct credentials to /api/auth/login
acceptanceCriteria.then: a JWT token is returned and the user is authenticated

acceptanceCriteria.given: A protected endpoint is called with an invalid or expired token

features.name: Create & List Chat Rooms
features.description: Users can create new chat rooms with a name and description, and view a list of all available rooms.
features.userStory: As a user, I want to create a chat room with a name and description, and see all existing rooms.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A logged‑in user sends a POST to /api/rooms with name and description
acceptanceCriteria.then: the room is persisted and returned with an ID
a list of rooms (id, name, description, member count) is returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user attempts to create a room without a name

features.name: Send & Receive Messages
features.description: Real‑time messaging within a room, persisting messages to the database and delivering them instantly to participants.
features.userStory: As a user, I want to send a text message to a room and see it instantly.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A logged‑in user sends a POST to /api/messages with room_id and content
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message is returned with an ID and timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user subscribes to a room's Socket.IO channel
acceptanceCriteria.when: another user sends a message to that room
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message is broadcast to all subscribers in real time

acceptanceCriteria.given: A message is sent to a non‑existent room
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 404 Not Found response is returned

features.name: Message History & Pagination
features.description: Retrieve message history for a room with pagination to support scrolling through past messages.
features.userStory: As a user, I want to scroll through past messages in a room.

acceptanceCriteria.then: up to 20 messages are returned with pagination metadata

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user requests messages for a room they are not a member of
A user requests a page beyond the total pages
acceptanceCriteria.then: an empty array is returned with correct pagination metadata

features.name: Presence & Online Status
features.description: Show which users are online in a room, updating in real time as users join/leave.
features.userStory: As a user, I want to see the online status of other participants.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user connects to Socket.IO and joins a room
acceptanceCriteria.then: a presence event is emitted to all room subscribers indicating the user is online
a presence event is emitted indicating the user is offline

acceptanceCriteria.given: A client subscribes to presence updates for a room
acceptanceCriteria.then: the client receives a presence update with the user's ID and timestamp

features.name: WebSocket Real‑Time Communication
features.description: Use Socket.IO for bi‑directional real‑time messaging, reducing latency compared to HTTP polling.
features.userStory: As a user, I want messages to appear instantly without page refresh.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A client establishes a WebSocket connection to /socket.io
acceptanceCriteria.when: a message is sent via Socket.IO
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message is broadcast to all room subscribers within 100ms

acceptanceCriteria.given: A client sends a typing indicator event
acceptanceCriteria.when: another user is in the same room
acceptanceCriteria.then: the recipient receives a typing event

acceptanceCriteria.given: The server restarts while clients are connected
acceptanceCriteria.then: clients automatically re‑establish the connection and resume receiving events

nonFunctional: Performance: messages should be delivered within 100ms under moderate load.
Security: JWT tokens must be HTTP‑Only, use HTTPS, and have a 24‑hour expiration.
Accessibility: UI components must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
Scalability: Architecture should support horizontal scaling of message handling.

tables.name: room_members
tables.description: Many‑to‑many relationship between users and rooms.

api.description: Register a new user and return a JWT token.
Authenticate user and return a JWT token.
List all chat rooms for the authenticated user.
Retrieve paginated message history for a room.
Send a new message to a room.
Get list of currently online users (optional).
WebSocket endpoint for real‑time messaging and presence.

steps.title: Architecture & Setup
steps.description: Define project structure, choose CI/CD, set up Docker, create shared libraries and linting rules.

steps.title: Core Backend & DB
steps.description: Design and create PostgreSQL schema, implement basic CRUD repositories, and set up environment configuration.

steps.title: Authentication & User Management
steps.description: Implement registration and login endpoints, JWT handling, password hashing, and unit tests.

steps.title: Chat Core (Rooms & Messaging)
steps.description: Build room creation/list endpoints, message sending, and message history with pagination.

steps.title: Real‑Time & UI
steps.description: Add Socket.IO server, presence tracking, and develop React frontend components for auth, room list, and chat window.

steps.title: Testing & Deployment
steps.description: Write integration/e2e tests, configure Docker images, set up CI pipeline, and perform security hardening.

tasks.title: Initialize monorepo with root package.json and workspaces
tasks.description: Create root package.json, set up pnpm workspaces for frontend and backend, and add basic scripts (dev, build, test).
acceptance: Repository cloned and `pnpm install` runs without errors

tasks.title: Add README and contribution guidelines
tasks.description: Write a comprehensive README covering setup, deployment, and API usage; add a CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance: README includes installation, running, and testing instructions

tasks.title: Design database schema and migration files
tasks.description: Create SQL migration scripts for users, rooms, messages, and room_members tables with constraints and indexes.

tasks.title: Create users table
tasks.description: Implement migration to create the users table with id, username, email, password_hash, and created_at columns.
acceptance: Columns have correct types and constraints

tasks.title: Create rooms table
tasks.description: Implement migration to create the rooms table with id, name, description, created_by (FK to users), and created_at.
acceptance: Foreign key constraint to users.id is enforced

tasks.title: Create messages table
tasks.description: Implement migration to create the messages table with id, room_id (FK to rooms), user_id (FK to users), content, and sent_at.

tasks.title: Create room_members join table
tasks.description: Implement migration for room_members linking users and rooms with joined_at timestamp.

tasks.title: Implement user registration endpoint
tasks.description: Create POST /api/auth/register in auth controller, hash password, save user, return JWT.
acceptance: Endpoint returns 201 with token on success

tasks.title: Implement login endpoint and JWT generation
tasks.description: Create POST /api/auth/login, validate credentials, sign JWT with 24h expiry, return token.
acceptance: Endpoint returns 200 with token for valid credentials

tasks.title: Write unit tests for authentication
tasks.description: Add Jest tests for registration and login controllers, covering success and error cases.

tasks.title: Implement create room endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/rooms handler that validates name, creates room, sets created_by from JWT, adds creator as member.
acceptance: Room created and returned with ID
Creator automatically added as room member

tasks.title: Implement list rooms endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /api/rooms that returns rooms the authenticated user has joined, with member count.
acceptance: Endpoint returns list of rooms with name, description, member count
Only rooms user joined are shown

tasks.title: Implement send message endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/messages that validates room_id and content, saves message, returns message object.
acceptance: Message persisted and returned with ID and timestamp

tasks.title: Implement message history endpoint with pagination
tasks.description: Add GET /api/rooms/:id/messages supporting query parameters page and limit, returns paginated messages.
acceptance: Paginated response includes messages, total, page, limit

tasks.title: Implement presence tracking in database
tasks.description: Add a presence table (or use Redis) to store user online status per room; create helper functions.
acceptance: Presence data can be inserted/updated on connection
Presence can be queried for a room

tasks.title: Set up Socket.IO server and middleware
tasks.description: Initialize Socket.IO in Express, attach authentication middleware, and configure message and presence namespaces.

tasks.title: Implement real‑time message broadcasting
tasks.description: Handle incoming message events, persist to DB, and broadcast to all room subscribers via Socket.IO.
acceptance: Messages sent via Socket.IO appear instantly to all room subscribers
Broadcast includes sender ID and timestamp

tasks.title: Build React login component
tasks.description: Create LoginPage component with username/password fields, submit to /api/auth/login, store JWT in httpOnly cookie.
acceptance: Successful login redirects to room list

tasks.title: Build React register component
tasks.description: Create RegisterPage component with fields for username, email, password, submit to /api/auth/register.

tasks.title: Build React room list component
tasks.description: Create RoomList component that fetches /api/rooms, displays rooms, and navigates to chat on selection.
acceptance: Room list loads and shows each room's name and description
Clicking a room opens chat view

tasks.title: Build React chat window component
tasks.description: Create ChatWindow component that joins Socket.IO room, displays messages, and provides a message input.
acceptance: Chat window shows messages in real time
New messages appear without page refresh

tasks.title: Integrate JWT authentication into React routes
tasks.description: Add protected route logic using the httpOnly cookie, redirect to login if missing token.

tasks.title: Write integration tests for chat flow
tasks.description: Create end‑to‑end tests using Supertest and Cypress covering registration, room creation, messaging, and presence.
acceptance: Scenarios cover happy path and error cases

tasks.title: Configure Docker for backend and frontend
tasks.description: Create Dockerfile and docker-compose for Node service and Nginx for React, define environment variables.
acceptance: Services start and expose required ports

tasks.title: Set up CI pipeline with GitHub Actions
tasks.description: Create workflow that runs lint, tests, and builds on push to main, and deploys to staging environment.
acceptance: CI runs on PR and main

tasks.title: Add security hardening (helmet, rate limiting)
tasks.description: Integrate helmet, express-rate-limit, and CORS policies to protect endpoints.

tasks.title: Implement performance monitoring (Prometheus exporter)
tasks.description: Add a simple metrics endpoint exposing request count and latency for monitoring.
acceptance: Metrics endpoint returns JSON with counters
Metrics can be scraped by Prometheus

edgeCases: User attempts to send a message to a room they are not a member of
Duplicate messages due to network retries
Large message history causing pagination performance issues
Socket.IO connection drops and client reconnection
Concurrent room creation with same name
Invalid JWT token or token missing from request
Database connection failure during message persistence
Spam messages from a single user
outOfScope: Advanced UI theming and custom branding
Real‑time typing indicators (planned for future iteration)
